subject: Final go/no-go checklist, eSign timing, and start-date cadence for Acme MAP
messages:
From: Ella Ramirez <ella@acme.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acme.com>, contracts@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and timeline — questions before exec signoff

Michael —

Thanks for sending the MAP and the SOW. We reviewed the documents with legal and procurement this morning. A couple quick asks before we take this to our execs for the final go/no-go: 

- Can you confirm the committed latency SLA for the dedicated pool (p95) and whether there's a credit ladder?
- We need the final start date to be 2027-01-10 or later — can you confirm your operational readiness and onboarding cadence if we sign that date?
- Legal flagged two small redlines in section 4.2 (data retention) — I attached their note.

If you can confirm SLA language and a clear e-sign window (DocuSign) we can get signoff next week.

Ella
Procurement Manager, Acme Retail

Attachments: Acme_legal_note_section4.2.pdf (text/plain)
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Ella Ramirez <ella@acme.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and timeline — questions before exec signoff

Ella — thanks for the quick review and the flags. Answers inline below and next steps at the bottom.

- SLA: p95 latency (in-region) for the dedicated pool is 120ms; we include a rolling 3-month SLA measurement window and a credit schedule: 5% credit for p95 between 120–180ms, 10% for 180–250ms, >250ms we escalate to remediation + custom credit. I can paste the SLA paragraph into the SOW if useful.

- Start date: 2027-01-10 is fine from our side. Our onboarding cadence for dedicated customers is: 
  * Week -4: provisioning and network connectivity (VPC peering / firewall rules)
  * Week -3: model onboarding, baseline evals with your sample prompts
  * Week -2: load/kiosk testing and KV cache tuning
  * Week 0 (start week): blue/green handover and cutover plan; production monitoring run for 72 hours

- Data retention redline: we can accept 90-day session retention by default and offer custom retention windows as an add-on; I'll note this in section 4.2 for legal.

Next steps: I'll update the SOW and MAP, attach the specific SLA paragraph, and push a DocuSign envelope with a 7-day signing window starting Tuesday 2026-11-09. If you sign by 2026-11-16 we can lock the 2027-01-10 start slot.

Kimberly and Jordan — looping you in for approvals on the SLA language and the DocuSign envelope timing.

Best,
Michael Grant
Sr. Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sla-p95-paragraph.txt
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T12:10:00Z
Subject: Fwd: SLA paragraph + proposed DocuSign window (internal)

Team — forwarding what Michael drafted. Quick internal notes before we send updated artifacts: 

- SLA paragraph looks good. Legal_compliance asked for a short exception clause for region failover; I propose we include a brief line: "In cases of region failover, Redwood will use the nearest available region and notify the customer; p95 guarantees are calculated within single-region operation unless otherwise agreed."

- DocuSign timing: 7-day window is fine but recommend we set the envelope to expire 10 calendar days after sent to accommodate procurement holidays. That still meets Acme's timeline and gives us margin.

I'll update the SOW with the section language and prepare the DocuSign. Michael — can you confirm the 10-day expiry and I'll queue the envelope?

Kim
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Ella Ramirez <ella@acme.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acme.com>
Cc: contracts@acme.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:22:00Z
Subject: Updated MAP, SOW and eSign plan for Exec review

Ella / Tom — attaching the revised MAP (v3) and SOW with the SLA paragraph and updated data-retention language (section 4.2). Highlights: 

- SLA p95 language inserted; added region-failover note per internal counsel.
- Data retention: default 90 days; custom retention options available as an add-on (call out in section 4.2).
- DocuSign: envelope will be sent 2026-11-09 with a 10-day expiry (expires 2026-11-19). Please let us know if you need the envelope earlier.
- Start date: we have tentatively reserved 2027-01-10 as the customer start slot pending execution. If signed after 2026-11-19 the on-boarding start would shift by one week per calendar week of signing delay.

We aim to have Exec signoff by 2026-11-16 with signatures in DocuSign the week of 11/09–11/19. After signature we'll share the onboarding playbook and kickoff invite.

Thanks,
Michael

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v3.pdf; SOW_ACME_v1.2.docx; redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx
From: Ella Ramirez <ella@acme.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@acme.com>, contracts@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-04T16:45:00Z
Subject: RE: Updated MAP, SOW and eSign plan for Exec review

Michael —

This looks good and aligns with our procurement timeline. Acme execs want two final confirmations before we route to signature tomorrow: 

1) Confirm the DocuSign expiry is 10 days (you mentioned that) and that you will re-send if required before expiry.
2) Confirm an onboarding kickoff invite will be scheduled within 48 hours of DocuSign completion with an initial 60-minute runbook review (we need that to lock internal calendar).

If both are confirmed we will kick the exec queue tomorrow and expect signatures within the DocuSign window. Once signed we will confirm the 2027-01-10 start date in the onboarding invite.

Ella
Procurement Manager, Acme Retail
